implementation_provenance.method: Local optimized evaluation harness matching the repository's patient-group split, preprocessing, logistic regression, feature definitions, and fixed threshold. This was not run as a GitHub Actions job or directly through the repository CLI.
implementation_provenance.memory_strategy: Preallocated float32 feature matrix and vectorized trailing rolling means.
implementation_provenance.status: internal full-cohort rerun; aggregate metrics only

protocol.model: SimpleImputer(median, add_indicator=True) + StandardScaler + LogisticRegression(max_iter=500, class_weight=balanced, solver=lbfgs)
protocol.threshold_note: Fixed reference threshold; not clinically optimized and not selected using validation data.
protocol.temporal_features: Per-patient one-hour lag, one-hour difference, and trailing six-row mean for candidate physiological measurements.

warnings: EtCO2 was entirely missing in the cohort and was skipped by median imputation, along with its temporal derivatives.
The local harness used the same intended model and split protocol but was not launched through the repository CLI; a direct CLI run should still be recorded as the definitive reproducibility check.
No patient-cluster bootstrap intervals were computed for this rerun yet.
interpretation_limits: Retrospective evaluation on one challenge dataset only.
Metrics are hourly-row metrics, not patient-level event-detection metrics.
Positive SepsisLabel rows follow the challenge's early-warning label definition and are not independently observed clinical onset.
The fixed 0.5 threshold is not a clinically selected operating point; PPV is low at this threshold.
The temporal feature variant has better point estimates on this split, but this does not prove clinical benefit or generalizability.
No external validation, prospective evaluation, clinical impact study, novelty assessment, or patentability assessment.
